topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's scope and learning objectives regarding cancer evolution, cell of origin, and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms in Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages to drive clonal expansion during early tumorigenesis.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate the role of tissue stem cell hierarchies and investigate whether tumors are initiated and propagated by cancer stem cells.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and Stromal Support in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate how environmental promoters, inflammation, and supportive stroma cooperate with mutations to permit malignant outgrowth and tumor maintenance.

topics.label: Experimental and Computational Methods for Profiling Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: It describes the sequencing technologies, spatial profiling methods, and computational tools used to study tumor evolution and cell interactions in tissues.

topics.label: Multifactorial Synthesis of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes the interplay among mutational accumulation, epigenetic plasticity, cell of origin, and microenvironmental cues into an integrated evolutionary framework of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
